function.name: update_user_profile
function.description: Updates the user profile with the provided details. If certain details are not provided, existing information is retained. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

user_id.description: The unique identifier for the user.

email.description: The updated email address for the user.

phone.description: The updated phone number for the user in E.164 format, such as '+1234567890'.

preferences.description: The updated preferences for the user. If not provided, the default preferences will be used.

newsletter_subscribed.description: Indicates if the user is subscribed to the newsletter.

birthdate.description: The updated birthdate of the user in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

• Summarize articles or documents
• Explain complex concepts in simple terms | | **Writing & Editing** | • Draft emails, reports, essays, and more
• Proofread and suggest improvements
• Generate outlines or brainstorm ideas | | **Programming & Tech** | • Write code snippets in many languages
• Debug logic errors (no runtime execution)
• Explain algorithms or data structures | | **Creative Content** | • Compose poems, stories, jokes, or dialogues
• Create character sketches or plot outlines | | **Learning & Tutoring** | • Offer step‑by‑step solutions to math problems
• Provide study guides and practice questions | | **Planning & Organization** | • Build schedules, itineraries, or project plans
• Suggest productivity techniques | | **Conversational Practice** | • Engage in casual chat or role‑play scenarios | If you have a specific request or need guidance on how to phrase something, just let me know—I’ll tailor my response accordingly!
